Senior Software Engineer | Machine Control

Help shape the future of machine automation.

Every day, construction professionals around the world rely on Leica Geosystems technology to work more safely, efficiently, and more sustainable.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with expertise in kinematics and control systems to join our On-Machine Software team in Odense, Denmark, or Stockholm, Sweden. In this role, you will develop the software that enable construction machines to operate with greater precision, automation, and autonomy.

About the role

You will be part of the On-Machine Software department, where we design and develop developing technology used every day on construction sites around the world. Our software allows construction machines to understand their surroundings and execute precise movements.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from concept and architecture discussions to implementation, testing, and operational support. You will collaborate with software, hardware, and product teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions.

A particular focus of this role will be supporting and evolving key machine control applications while contributing expertise in system design, software architecture, kinematics, control systems, sensor integration, and advanced software development practices.

What you’ll do

• Develop and maintain software for machine control and automation systems.

• Contribute to technical decisions, architecture, and system design.

• Take ownership of key software components and drive improvements.

• Collaborate across software, hardware, and product teams to deliver reliable solutions.

• Develop machine guidance, automation, and control functionality.

• Participate in technical reviews and mentoring of colleagues.

• Work with sensor integration, positioning technologies, and control algorithms.

• Contribute to technical investigations and innovation initiatives.

What you'll bring

You have a degree in Software Engineering, Robotics, Control Engineering, or a related technical discipline and several years of professional software development experience.

You thrive on tackling complex system-level challenges and are often the person colleagues turn to for technical guidance. While you work well independently when needed, you also enjoy collaborating with others and sharing your expertise in our global organization.

We expect you to have:

• Strong C++ development skills.

• Experience developing software on Linux-based platforms.

• Experience working across the full software development lifecycle.

• Understanding of software architecture principles and object-oriented design.

• Experience developing sensor-fusion and state-estimation solutions.

• Deep understanding of kinematic modelling and control systems, ideally applied to robotics, mobile machinery, hydraulic systems, or automation.

Additional experience:

• Experience with embedded and real-time software development.

• CAN, CANopen, or similar communication technologies.

• Understanding of CRA, cybersecurity compliance, and secure software development practices.

• Experience developing safety-critical or safety-certified software.

• Experience from heavy construction, industrial automation, agriculture, or related industries.

• GNSS, positioning systems, or machine guidance solutions.

Language: Fluent English, both written and verbal, is a prerequisite.

Travel: Occasional travel may be required, for example to visit other development locations.

Your workplace

At Leica Geosystems, you will be working on technology that truly matters to the people who use it. For over 40 years, we've helped construction professionals build more efficiently, more safely, and more sustainably. Our products are used in more than 80 countries and are integrated with over 10 leading OEM construction machinery manufacturers. Today, more than 10,000 of our systems shape roads, railways, and infrastructure every day.

Leica Geosystems Machine Control is part of Hexagon's Infrastructure & Geospatial Business Area. Hexagon is the global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. Because when it has to be right, it has to be Hexagon.

We believe in a work environment characterised by humour, engagement, and opportunities for growth.

Three good reasons to join us:

• Build technology that moves the world and help construction machines work with millimetre precision.

• Push the boundaries of automation, and help develop smarter, more autonomous construction machines.

• Enjoy the freedom to do your best work and join a team built on trust and flexibility,

We are looking for a motivated scientist with strong scientific expertise to join our international Applications team. As part of Commercial Operations, the team works closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Product Management, and R&D to help customers succeed with Evosep technology.

In this role, you will combine hands-on science, scientific communication, and cross-functional collaboration. You will help test and validate new products, generate high-quality scientific data, and translate complex results into clear, actionable insights for internal and external audiences. The position is based at our headquarters in Odense, Denmark, with a hybrid work setup. Occasional travel, typically once a month, is expected.

You will join a collaborative and international team driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and a shared belief that we achieve more together. Our ambition is to help scientists accelerate breakthroughs and advance precision medicine through robust, high-throughput proteomics workflows.

Evosep aims to improve quality of life and patient care by radically innovating protein based clinical diagnostics. Making sample preparation and separation before MS analysis 10 times faster and 100 times more robust will enable truly large cohort studies for biomarker validation and provide the foundation for precision medicine.

• Stay current on emerging technologies and methodologies.

Healper a game-changing booking platform that matches people with mental health issues such as depression, anxiety, and addiction with the psychologist who fits their needs. Problem: The cumbersome booking of the wrong psychologist In Denmark, mental disorders account for 25% of the disease burden and cost society 55 billion DKK annually with more than 2,000 people receiving therapy from a psychologist every day. Further, too many individuals do not receive timely help as they cannot cope with the draining 5-hour process it takes to find and book a psychologist. At the same time, U.S. experience shows that only 20-40% of people find a psychologist they trust and have 'chemistry' with. This is tragic, as just one bad experience can cause a client to completely drop out of or postpone his/her therapy. The ineffective booking process and the risk of a poor patient-therapist match mean that many people continue to struggle with mental illness who could otherwise be treated. This has major consequences for individuals whose mental illness markedly impairs their quality of life, but also largely affect their family and friends. Furthermore, this is a major problem for society, which is negatively impacted by lost labor and growth and must shoulder the high costs associated with mental illness. Solution: A simple approach to booking the right psychologist Healper is a friendly guide and a booking platform that matches clients with psychologists. We have designed a comfortable, simple, and transparent user journey, that takes the client by the hand and helps him/her through therapy to mental health. Clients fill out a short questionnaire and are then matched with the best results from our database of more than 1,700 psychologists. Here, we find the psychologist who can statistically give the best treatment. Clients are presented with a prioritized list of three psychologists along with the reasons for the match. From this list, clients can choose which psychologist they like best, book a session, and pay. The platform continuously facilitates feedback from clients and their psychologists to improve the processing and precision of the matches.
